text.p: Lithuania's Mazeikiu oil refinery ended a 10-day shutdown on Friday, the Baltic News Service (BNS) reported.
Supply problems had forced the troubled refinery to close on August 26.
BNS quoted a plant official as saying that Mazeikiu had received 100,000 tonnes of crude from its Russian suppliers and was expecting 300,000 tonnes in the next few days.
The refinery is hoping for two $9.5 million loans from Merrill Lynch and is negotiating a $40 million loan deal with Chase Manhattan.
The problem-plagued refinery processed 1.3 million tonnes of crude in the first six months of this year, 25 percent of its capacity, and posted a loss of 56 million litas.
